project.purpose: Two reusable solution inner pages for the Laxmi En-Fab website
project.design_direction: Premium editorial industrial storytelling, image-led, technical, spacious, minimal cards

principles: real Laxmi plant and machinery imagery

rules: Do not invent machinery specifications, capacities, dimensions, certifications, performance figures or project claims.
Use the brochure as the factual source for AAC plant, AAC panel, machinery and Dry Mix Mortar content.
Use current company contact details rather than old brochure contact details.
Keep both pages visually related but do not make them identical.
The solution page should explain the complete plant/system, not read like a machinery catalog.
Use real brochure imagery wherever suitable.

pages.title: AAC Block & Panel Plant
pages.purpose: Present Laxmi's AAC block and panel plant as a complete production system, from raw material preparation through curing and finished-product handling.

seo.title: AAC Block & Panel Plant | Laxmi En-Fab Pvt. Ltd.
seo.description: Explore Laxmi En-Fab's AAC block and panel plant solutions, including plant process, machinery, engineering flow and end-to-end production.

hero.headline: Build your AAC plant as one complete production system.
hero.subtext: From raw material preparation to finished blocks and panels, the plant is planned around the relationship between process, machinery, handling and curing.
hero.visual_direction: Full-bleed cinematic AAC plant or machinery image from the brochure, with restrained technical overlay.

intro.headline: An AAC plant is more than a collection of machines.
intro.body: The brochure presents an integrated AAC production journey covering raw material preparation, slurry and batching operations, pouring, precuring, demoulding and wire cutting, steam curing in autoclaves, and finished-product handling.
intro.layout: Large statement on one side, supporting plant image and short technical line on the other.

production_journey.headline: One production journey. Engineered stage by stage.

stages.title: Raw Material Preparation
stages.description: Prepare and process the required raw materials before they enter the production sequence.

stages.title: Slurry Making & Storage
stages.description: Prepare slurry and maintain the material flow required for batching and pouring.

stages.title: Batching & Pouring
stages.description: Bring the prepared materials together and move the mix into the casting process.

stages.title: Precuring & Moulding
stages.description: Allow the cast material to move through precuring and mould-related operations.

stages.title: Demoulding & Wire Cutting
stages.description: Release the cast cake and process it through the cutting sequence to form the required product geometry.

stages.title: Handling & Grouping
stages.description: Move and organize cakes or products between major production stages.

stages.title: Steam Curing
stages.description: Cure the cut products inside autoclaves as part of the AAC production process.

stages.title: Finished Product & Packing
stages.description: Handle finished AAC products and prepare them for dispatch.

products.headline: Designed for AAC blocks and panels.
products.intro: The brochure covers AAC blocks, including standard and interlocking forms, along with reinforced AAC panels for wall, floor and roof applications.

items.title: AAC Blocks
items.description: Standard and interlocking AAC block formats presented in the product section of the brochure.

items.title: AAC Panels
items.description: Reinforced AAC panel applications covering wall, floor and roof use cases.

machinery_story.headline: Every machine has a place in the production story.
machinery_story.body: Instead of presenting equipment as isolated products, connect each major machine to the production stage where it contributes.
machinery_story.interaction: Scrollable machine-to-process relationship. Selecting a production stage reveals the relevant machinery without turning the page into a card grid.

engineering_proof.headline: See how the plant comes together.
engineering_proof.body: Use the plant layout experience to show the physical relationship between production stages, machinery and movement through the facility.
engineering_proof.visual: Large GA/3D plant layout visual from Laxmi source material.

plant_support.headline: From plant concept to production.
plant_support.body: Keep this section focused on the complete project journey described by Laxmi's positioning, without adding unsupported service promises.

project_proof.headline: Engineering is best understood through working plants.
project_proof.body: Use selected installation, expansion and workshop/dispatched-equipment imagery from the brochure as visual evidence.

decision_section.headline: Before choosing machinery, understand the plant.

final_cta.headline: Planning an AAC block or panel plant?
final_cta.subtext: Start with the production system, then work backward to the machinery.

pages.title: Dry Mix Mortar Plant
pages.purpose: Present the Dry Mix Mortar Plant as a focused solution page using only the Dry Mix Mortar information and associated product imagery supported by the Laxmi brochure.

seo.title: Dry Mix Mortar Plant | Laxmi En-Fab Pvt. Ltd.
seo.description: Explore Laxmi En-Fab's Dry Mix Mortar Plant solution and understand the production system, plant context and related products.

hero.headline: A production system built around consistent dry-mix processing.
hero.subtext: Laxmi En-Fab's brochure presents Dry Mix Mortar Plant as a separate solution within its plant and machinery portfolio.
hero.visual_direction: Use the strongest Dry Mix Mortar Plant/product visual available in the brochure. Avoid generic stock imagery when source imagery exists.

intro.headline: The plant should be understood as a production flow, not a machine list.
intro.body: Keep the page focused on the Dry Mix Mortar Plant solution shown in the brochure. Explain the plant at a high level without inventing a process sequence or equipment specification that is not supported by the source.
intro.layout: Editorial two-column composition with a large statement and a full-height plant/product image.

system_view.headline: From material input to finished dry mix.
system_view.body: Use a simple visual system diagram based strictly on the process and equipment information available in the source material. Where the brochure does not specify a stage, show the stage as a conceptual placeholder only in the design data and do not publish unsupported technical details.
system_view.interaction: Horizontal process line with restrained hover/focus states.
system_view.fallback: If the source imagery or process information is insufficient for a detailed interactive flow, keep this section visual and high-level rather than fabricating steps.

points.title: Plant Context
points.description: Show where the Dry Mix Mortar Plant sits within Laxmi En-Fab's broader plant and machinery offering.

points.title: Production Thinking
points.description: Frame the solution around coordinated plant operation rather than isolated equipment.

points.title: Project Understanding
points.description: Connect the solution to engineering, plant planning and project discussion without adding unsupported technical claims.

visual_story.headline: See the plant, not just the brochure description.
media_sequence: Finished product/application image if supported by the source
visual_story.layout: Large editorial image sequence with captions and thin technical annotations.

engineering_connection.headline: Plant engineering starts before equipment selection.
engineering_connection.body: Use the Engineering Center and Plant Layout pages to move the visitor from solution understanding into plant planning and physical arrangement.

decision_section.headline: Understand the solution before discussing the equipment.

final_cta.headline: Planning a Dry Mix Mortar Plant?
final_cta.subtext: Bring the project requirement first. The right equipment conversation follows from it.
